reproduction.first_failing_check: versions health and binds revoke to the exact owner/session index

root_cause.problem: The existing Worker health response was not versioned as a named service, revoke authorized only the owner instead of the exact owner/session index, and the Host flattened provider and parsing failures into unstable free text.
root_cause.resolution: The existing /emate.share Host and Share Worker now use one schema-versioned staged result, validate the fixed public origin/path, bind revoke to owner plus session hash, clean an expired archive and its index together, and map trust-boundary failures to stable local code/message pairs.
root_cause.single_path: Share UI -> /emate.share -> managed model-session credential -> native Session ZIP -> Share Worker -> immutable R2 object/public URL -> owner/session index -> list -> revoke/expiry

stage_receipts.receipt: Worker returns exact schema_version=1, service=emate-share, version=1 and ready=true; Host exposes preparing/service_version=1.
Missing or rejected managed credential maps to failed/create/preparing/authentication-required and never reaches upload.
The Host reuses apiProxy.downloads.sessionLog with application/zip and maps export failure to archive-unavailable without a second archive path.
The Worker streams the ZIP into the existing object binding; unauthenticated public open and archive download are covered without logging body or credential data.
Host accepts only the configured origin and exact /s/<share_id> path with no credentials, query or fragment.
List is reconstructed from the persisted owner/session index on a later stateless Worker request and excludes other owners and sessions.
Revoke requires exact owner plus session, returns an idempotent success after removal, and expiry returns 410 while deleting the matching archive/index pair.
UI exposes preparing/uploading/created/listing/revoking/failed progress, copy, expiry, retry and revoke; local ZIP remains explicitly local-only.
